provenance: OfficeIMO-owned synthetic OOXML with ordinary prose; no user document or private sample.
producer: Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365 16.0.20430.20182 on Windows
source_profile: The final body paragraph has no direct paragraph properties. Document defaults supply after160 twips and auto259 line spacing; note paragraphs use after0 and exact280 twips. The source distinguishes the final font box used by imported frame fitting from the full line advance used by note admission.
qualification: Public conversion must complete, preserve all visible glyphs and note order, and leave the source unchanged. Native page assignments are asserted only with the pinned Arial profile; font substitution remains explicit and does not claim native geometry.
export: Read-only inert input, native Word repagination and PDF export before diagnostic getters; no repair or source save. Source, native binaries and fonts remained unchanged.
inert_parts: Eleven OOXML parts, no docProps, VBA, external relationships, field instructions, embedded objects or altChunk. Body/note content is generated ordinary prose.
causal_controls: Independent owned copies change only the final paragraph's after-space. Native Word places after0 on one page, inherited after8 and explicit after16 on two pages. The regression fixture remains the unchanged inherited-default input. These values are fixture inputs, not converter constants.
